scope: Registry-level paper eligibility gates bound to charter, benchmark, first observation date, and non-agent approval metadata.
implemented: Removed the boolean-only human_approved transition bypass.
Requires a complete, content-addressed charter matching the registered strategy and code digest.
Requires the charter's sole benchmark to match an immutable registered benchmark definition frozen before start_on.
Requires an unexpired STRATEGY_ENROLLMENT approval for the strategy whose scope digest equals the charter hash.
Rejects AI/non-human actor metadata, stale approval scopes, and incomplete evidence.
